openDecisions: OPEN DEC-RPT-001: Historical versus current master grouping, decided per report.
PROPOSED DEC-RPT-002: The Phase-2 baseline report list is the one in the Reporting FRS. The design follows that list; it is not frozen.
OPEN FR-RPT-050 / 016: Definitions of gross sales, discounts, returns, net sales and tax for reports. FR-RPT-016 requires "approved" definitions that no document states.
OPEN FR-RPT-044: Approved aging buckets and the due-date basis (with DEC-CRD-002).
OPEN DEC-INV-007: Who owns the reorder or low-stock threshold.
OPEN DEC-INV-004 / 005: Batch selection and expiry/FEFO policy; DEC-POS-003 expiry-sale policy is VERIFY.
OPEN DEC-INV-003: Stock-count concurrency policy.
OPEN DEC-RET-001: Whether no-receipt returns exist and under what eligibility.
OPEN DEC-CRD-001 / 002 / 003 / 004: Credit limit, collection allocation, customer advance and suspended-credit override policies.
OPEN DEC-CSH-001..005, DEC-COM-001: Business-date rollover, day close, late transactions, reopen and active-shift policies.
PROPOSED DEC-PAY-001: Card and QR adapter baseline behaviour.
VERIFY DEC-CUS-002: Customer retention and anonymisation period.
PROPOSED DEC-PUR-001 / 002 / 006: Purchase-order and direct-GRN policy. Tax recoverability is VERIFY.
GAP: Report codes, name keys, filter field codes and operators are not frozen
GAP: No frozen screen owns Cash/Shift/Day-close reports or the Management Daily Summary
GAP: Permissions beyond reporting.read and reporting.write are not defined
GAP: Hand-off from a report to Export Center is not described
GAP: Page limits differ between contracts
GAP: No central or multi-branch report screen exists (Phase 3)
GAP: Print channel, page size and orientation are undefined
GAP: Audit policy for report access and export is undefined
GAP: Export artifact retention is a policy seam
GAP: Performance targets and the acceptance suite are not visual

changelog.summary: Integrated the Claude Design adaptation of the Claude Code candidate, revision V2 (MiniMart_Reporting_ClaudeDesign_Source-V2.zip; V1 archive retained as upstream history): registered the exact exported source, six grouped pages, the index, support.js and the export manifest. Status review-ready. Repository integration adjustments: index and Sales Reports badge/pill nowrap, Back Office link repointed to the repository target, V1-only diff statement replaced by the verified V2 comparison.

Owner approved Reporting V2 as an approved-visual-reference (visual authority only), bound to the integrated source hashes recorded in provenance.json (source SHA-256 8a9219669a1b5fda95f90df1705e9836ff1a460aa972c2a61ceb2e0e652db662). Accepted limitations: static export dialogs and 1366 px grouped canvases. Design-intent coverage and unresolved authority are retained. No implementation, business, API or security decision is approved or resolved.

Owner-authorized status-text correction: stale review-time status wording replaced by the approved-visual-reference wording in the index badge and footer, the source script comment and documentation screen 80. No layout, behaviour or requirement change; approval binding recomputed to source SHA-256 8a9219669a1b5fda95f90df1705e9836ff1a460aa972c2a61ceb2e0e652db662.

notes: Reviewable Reporting visual design (UI-RPT-001..005 and the report, state, export and print behaviour required by FR-RPT-001..065). Every figure is illustrative and flagged on screen. No report calculation, financial definition, export contract, permission or access rule is invented; unresolved items are marked OPEN, VERIFY, PROPOSED or GAP and listed in screen 78. Groups follow the six grouped pages exported with the source. routeOrState and phaseLabel remain unset because the source does not assign them. The package ships the real support.js (byte-identical to the accepted Accounting-Lite copy). Owner visual approval was recorded on 2026-10-04 as approved-visual-reference, visual authority only. Retained limitations: the export dialogs are static illustrations, the grouped pages are 1366 px canvases, 30 of 146 requirement claims are mapped by design intent only, and unresolved decisions (DEC-RPT-001 OPEN, DEC-RPT-002 PROPOSED, the items on screen 78) are not resolved. This approval does not approve implementation or any business, API or security decision; frozen authority wins on any conflict.
